versions.content: Service Name CanIf_SetDynamicTxId Syntax void CanIf_SetDynamicTxId ( PduIdType CanIfTxSduId, Can_IdType CanId ) Service ID [hex] 0x0c Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant CanIfTxSduId L-SDU handle to be transmitted. This handle specifies the corresponding CAN L-SDU ID and implicitly the CAN Driver instance as well as the corresponding CAN controller device. Parameters (in) CanId Standard/Extended CAN ID of CAN L-SDU that shall be transmitted as FD or conventional CAN frame. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description This service reconfigures the corresponding CAN identifier of the requested CAN L-PDU. Available via CanIf.h
